title: StakePoolOperator Scripts (SPO Scripts) - New Features / Updates

ms.promise:
The StakepoolOperator Scripts are used by SPOs since the Shelley launch, they are a Suite of Scripts to do daily and advanced work on the CLI for SPOs and also Advanced Cardano users. 
The SPO Scripts can be found on the Github-Repo: https://github.com/gitmachtl/scripts
This milestones combines two stated milestones from the proposal:

・New feature "Transaction messages" for all scripts that do not support it yet.
・New feature "Encrypted transactions messages" for scripts with basic "Transactions messages" support

The transaction message and message encryption feature (CIP-83) will therefore be added to the following scripts:
・03b_regStakingAddrCert.sh (StakeKey Registration)
・08b_deregStakingAddrCert.sh (StakeKey Deregistration/Retirement)
・06_regDelegationCert.sh (Register Delegation Certificate)
・05c_regStakepoolCert.sh (StakePool Registration)
・07b_deregStakepoolCert.sh (StakePool Deregistration/Retirement)

---

This milestones combines two stated milestones from the proposal:
・New feature "Light-Mode" for a nodeless operation using Koios and other Online-APIs (no need to run a synced cardano-node locally)
・Advanced $adahandle support (CIP-67 subHandles)
・Updates/Maintenance on the Documentation and needed changes required to the Common-CoreScript via the Milestones

The first part of this milestone is the "Light-Mode" feature. Currently there is only an "online" and an "offline" mode. In online mode, an SPO/CLI user must run a locally synced instance of the cardano node. Thats the standard right now. The offline mode offers a method to generate and sign transactions on a machine that is not connected to the internet to increase security. 
---
